shots.tts: I got these cardboard boxes from Uline and you have to buy them in quantities of like five hundred. So I had millions of them for days. They were everywhere.
I felt like I could never run out.
So I used them for everything and I kept coming up with uses because I needed to figure out how to use them all up.
And then there's other things that are in short supply. Ideas. A lot of people have one good idea and that's it.
So they treat it very gently. Almost like they put it on a little velvet throne in a shoebox and they take care of it and pet it and are nice to it.
Certain things are just taken for granted because you have tons of them.
